Her final release in 2009 was her second Tamil feature film , the action masala film Vettaikaaran , where she appeared as a medical student . Shetty had a string of releases in 2010 . After appearing as a video jockey with SS Music , Lekha 's breakthrough film role was as an independent estranged sister in Jayamkondaan ( 2008 ) , whilst she has gone on to portray roles in the multi-starrer Vedam and the comedy Va. .

In 2012 , Arjun played the primary eye witness of a 1500 crore bank robbery , who fakes his death and leaves the city as a part of witness protection in Trivikram Srinivas ' Julai .
